edit.statement: A direct connection can be one-sided: router A being directly connected to router B does not mean router B is directly connected to router A.
edit.subject: isDirectlyConnectedTo
edit.original: Direct connections are mutual: if router A is directly connected to router B, then router B is directly connected to router A.
edit.scope: A direct link between two network devices, which works both ways in the original rule.
